title: The annual rebalancing review checklist
objectives: Run the seven-point annual review checklist.
Record “no action” with the date when no band is breached.
body_md:
Annual rebalancing review checklist. Pull the current mix across all holdings, by goal. Compare each asset class with target; note the drift in points. Any band breached? If not, record “no action” and the date. If yes, plan the cheapest route: new money, redirect, switch, then sell. Check exit loads and possible tax before any redemption. Check whether any goal now needs a new target (glide path). Get the client's approval and record what was done and why. Records matter: a simple log of date, drift, action and reason protects the client and the firm, and shows the decisions were rule-based.

> **Investor takeaway:** A simple log of date, drift, action and reason protects the client and the firm.
example: Band not breached: record “no action” and the date — that is a completed review, not a skipped one.
say: Record “no action” and the date when no band is breached.
A log of date, drift, action and reason shows decisions were rule-based.
never: Skip recording when nothing is done.
A review must always end in a trade.

check.q: Why agree the rule in writing at the start?
o: It is required by tax law
Later decisions follow the client’s calm choice
check.why: Later decisions follow the client’s calm choice. It removes emotion later.
